docs.text: 🌱 Hardneck garlic in the ground this morning! Just in time as snow is a possibility on the 10 day forecast! As long as you can work your soil in fall, it's not too late to plant. Lower Great lakes region, USA. #Zone6a #gardening #NWPA
Spring Break in the Great Lakes states. I'll be starting seeds indoors.

#TrumpProofing with #TherapyGardening. Perfect timing for #Gardening and saving money. Fortunately, we already added a #Greenhouse last year and very happy to have it. We’re #Zone6B just off the Lake Michigan shoreline (900ft) in Wisconsin.

Fall #garden harvest of #tomatoes. They are ripening fast, too! Located in #Wisconsin just off the shore of #Lake #Michigan in zone 5B. Fall here feels like mid-summer with our full Southern garden exposure. #Greenhouse is doing well with #eggplant, #peppers and #spinach.

#Gardening #2025 #green #house transforming to fall inside with Eggplants, Pepper Plant, Cucumber Plant, Tomato Plant and Spinach seedlings. Also shown are #roasted #sweet #peppers all four varieties of tomatoes. #Wisconsin close to #LakeMichigan Shorline.

#Yardisty #Greenhouse, #WI #zone5a, #Gardening2025, #organic. We’re now 4 months into the garden season in Wisconsin just off #LakeMichigan. All plants from seeds. GH now for lettuce, spinach, herbs and new seedlings. Initial seedlings in GH Feb 24th, 2025 and no heater!

We picked our first lemon pepper today! #Gardening #2025, #Wisconsin just off the shore of #Lake #Michigan. Also eggplant, 3 varieties of tomatoes and 2 other varieties of cucumbers. Most onions already harvested. Waiting on pole beans now. One miniature pumpkin plant, too. #Yardistry

Another day of IN and OUT weather #gardening here in #WI along the shores of #Lake #Michigan. Safer to protect than assume #hail won’t ruin months of prep work. Also keeping #backup #plants. Real summer about June 15th.

#MemorialDay #gardening #yardistry greenhouse. Getting ready for summer growing, which is still 2-3 weeks away here along #LakeMichigan in #WI. Onions, lettuce, spinach, radishes and asparagus doing well. Summer vegetable plants still indoors. Massive upgrades to outside garden area for 2025. Fun!

#Yardistry #Greenhouse #zone5b south exposure just off Lake Michigan in #WI. Late #fall #garden of #Spinach, #Lettuce, #Parsley, #Jumpups, using #growlights and no heater. Outside today 37F wind chill 25F. Spinach and Jumpup planting soon. Sunny days inside temps reach’s +70F. Lows averaging 25F.
Our #lettuce, #spinach and #parsley doing well in the #greenhouse. Low so far 25F and lettuce still happy. #Manitowoc, WI zone6b just off Lake Michigan.

#Garden getting upgraded with colored planter boxes. Two without legs will stay on a bench while the young transplants grow up. Like bunnies but know they like onion tops, too. #Gardening #2025 zone5a WI very close to #Lake Michigan.

#Gardening in #WI #Zone5a, 900’ off Lake Michigan. Today started #greenhouse transplanting with #LeafLettuce, #BunchingOnions and 2024 #Chives. Next up #Candy and #WallaWalla Onions. Greenhouse winter seed sowing started Feb 24th without a heater & coldest 10F. The GH has a full southern exposure.
I am new also, but an avid gardener willing to manage one for my area. I am in the Lower Great Lakes region, USA, Zone 6a.
Funny! Too early to deal with #garden weeds here zone5a/5b #WI just off Lake Michigan.

Correction: We picked our first #lemon #CUCUMBER today! #Gardening #2025, #Wisconsin just off the shore of #Lake #Michigan. Also eggplant, tomatoes and 2 other varieties of cucumbers. Most onions already harvested. Waiting on pole beans now. One miniature pumpkin plant, too.#Yardistry
Oh I plan do, but I live in the Great Lakes region, I can’t even start my seeds till late March and my early greens/peas outside till late April.

Wow, you are busy starting the #garden. We’re about 30% of that % #seeds in. Your temps exceed ours (zone 5a/b WI just off Lake Michigan (900ft) so have multiple climate zones in one. Temps now 15F at night maybe 40F daytime. Anxious to see growing progress.

Not a magical #gardener, but don’t use any #pesticides and do okay. Maybe this year even better. Started seeds in our #non-heated #greenhouse about 10 days ago and have lettuce and now spinach sprouting. Nighttime temps still mid teens and sunny days can be mid-70s. Zone 5a just off #Lake #Michigan.
Those veggies look amazing! I’m just going to start planting my vegetable garden today. Peas, carrots, beets, and some potatoes are going in today here in Ohio along Lake Erie.

#Gardening harvest 2024, which we either captured seeds or over-wintered #plants (#eggplant and #red #banana #pepper). Large #grape #tomatoes were fantastic and same with eggplant and red pepper. #zone5a 900ft from #LakeMichigan in #WI.
Here in Western New York the rule of thumb is wait to plant until Memorial Day weekend. I can get away with Mother's Day. Life in the Great Lakes.

Thanks Helen. The #Greenhouse will start to come to life w/in next 4-8 weeks. This is our 1st full year of the GH and it comes at a great time. Also we can see Lake Michigan from here. We left purple AZ for red WI in 2021 pandemic time (scary). Neighborhood mixed hat colors, but too many red ones.

Just wondering if anyone in the northeast, especially in the Great Lakes region, has experienced difficulty in starting their gardening this spring? We've had constant rain and temps 20 degrees below normal recently. My yard is swampy and I've just been able to plant some seeds in planters so far.
#Greenhouse #sweet-red-peppers and #eggplant harvest from plants brought inside a week ago. Outside 🍅 tomatoes winding down. #WI just off the shore of #LakeMichigan.
